text:
morgan: kick-off: proposal for a 'stitch-and-step' rollout for StitchRoute (routing + adaptive fallback stitching). goal: get perf wins but ensure predictable customer experience and fast automatic mitigation.

nina: quick summary of pattern?

morgan: pattern: per-route micro-canaries by fingerprint (not full-cookie) + tenant seed + staged regional weight expansion. fallback stitching: try cheap-quantized -> synthesis-only summarizer -> pin to stable -> Dedicated pool. rationale: synthesis-only reduces token usage while keeping UX.

diego: interesting. fingerprint micro-canary sounds good to avoid churn with cookies. suggest initial probe: 0.1% global (split us-west, eu-central), run 6h; if green -> 1% for 4h -> 8% for 2h -> 25% for 1h -> full. Each step needs 2 eval windows.

tara: telemetry gates we need: p95 latency delta, p50 tail-lag, 5xx rate, quality-eval delta (A/B on synthetic set), and user-visible degradation rate (synthesis fallback %). Also track token-cost delta and per-tenant error hotspots.

morgan: proposed probe thresholds:
```
- p95 latency increase <= 18ms
- 5xx spike <= +0.25% absolute
- quality-drop >= -0.5% absolute on eval set
- synthesis-fallback rate <= 0.8% of routed requests
- token-cost delta <= +9% relative
```
these are conservative for initial probe; tighten for broader ramps.

diego: automation: feature-flag `stitchroute_v1` with weights anchored to fingerprint buckets. auto-decrease policy: if any gate breaches for 2 consecutive windows, cut weight by 4x; if critical (5xx > +1%) immediate circuit-breaker to stable pool. log decays in routing audit.

tara: on fallback sequencing: need clear SLO mapping. synthesis-only fallback should be routed only for non-latency-sensitive routes (e.g., summarization) — add per-route annotation. Also add a human-review sampling for enterprise tenants at 0.5% of synthesis fallbacks.

morgan: customer ops: seed with 20 enterprise tenants (manual opt-in) for 48h, notify them and provide opt-out link. small tenants get randomized fingerprint allocation. include tenant-exclusion list in PR.

diego: infra tasks: add autoscale buffer for Dedicated fallback pools (+35%), ensure KV-cache warming when routing switches, and add trace tags for stitching decision path. Also implement a cost-throttle: if token-cost delta > +12% for 1h, pause new enrollments and notify bizops.

tara: quality tasks: extend eval harness with long-context and instruction-ambiguous prompts, add per-tenant small human QA, and set up an alert to research-oncall for >0.3% regression on seeded tenants.

ops-bot: deploy window blocked: runbook link required in PR. Emergency flag name should be `stitchroute_kill` and added to deploy description.

morgan: action items:
- morgan: open flag PR + runbook link, include tenant whitelist
- diego: implement auto-decrease/circuit-breaker + Dedicated buffers
- tara: patch eval harness + human review sampling
- nina: draft customer comms and opt-in flow

morgan: decision: proceed with stitch-and-step. timeline: start tenant seed 2026-07-12, micro-canaries 2026-07-14 pending runbook. owners as above. I'll tag follow-ups in GH.

nina: I'll have the customer note ready by EOD and coordinate tenant contacts :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: use `/deploy unlock` after runbook added to PR.
